evidence.source: Ministry of Education, Taiwan, Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants
evidence.field: 字樣說明; 正字 A02102 比-00-04
evidence.text: The current standard regular-script form 比 is shown as a four-stroke character: the left side is written as a short horizontal stroke and a rising vertical stroke; the right side as a short horizontal stroke and a curved-hook vertical stroke. The entry describes stroke forms and positions, but does not identify the two sides as 匕 components.
evidence.title: [A02102] 比 - Ministry of Education 《Dictionary of Chinese Character Variants》

search_audit.query: site:dict.variants.moe.edu.tw 比 部件 字形 正字; site:ephhk.com 比 字形 部件 教育局; site:humanum.arts.cuhk.edu.hk 比 字形 標準 字
search_audit.outcome: Search results surfaced the Taiwan Ministry of Education entry. Opened its current 比 headword: it labels 比 正字 and describes the standard regular-script form and stroke shapes. It does not say the current character is composed of two 匕. No other official page was opened.

gaps: No direct current-form component breakdown naming two 匕 parts was located in the inspected official entry; its statement concerns standard stroke form only.
